intro: The Europa is where smart storage meets great design. From strong shelves to hidden compartments, every detail is built to help you create a home that feels tidy, stylish, and perfectly put together.

features.title: A tall design that makes the most of your space
features.text: We’ve designed a vertical storage solution that maximises every inch, giving you more room to display books, décor, and keepsakes without taking up valuable floor space.

features.title: The perfect mix of open and closed storage
features.text: Showcase books, décor, or collectibles on open shelves while keeping personal items neatly tucked away in concealed compartments.

features.title: Easy maintenance for a hassle-free home
features.text: Life is busy, so we made sure our display unit is easy to clean. Its dust-resistant surfaces and durable materials keep it looking fresh with minimal effort.

features.title: Strong enough for even your heaviest books
features.text: Whether it’s a collection of hardcovers or statement décor, our sturdy construction gives you the strength and stability to store it all with confidence.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
